name: Baber Arjumand
headline: Software Engineer | Frontend Lead | Full-Stack
tagline: Software Engineer & Technical Leader — React, TypeScript, Node.js, Go

summary.label: Summary
summary.text: Software engineer and technical leader with over 6 years building production web and mobile products, in roles from Frontend Lead to CTO.

bullets: Own product and engineering for a marketplace matching students with private Quran teachers.
Direct booking, scheduling, teacher onboarding, and search visibility as sole technical owner.
Architected a B2B cross-border payment platform from concept to alpha in 8 months using React and Tailwind CSS.
Engineered Node.js, Express, and MongoDB services with Python microservices for financial reporting.
Integrated Mastercard Digital Asset Solutions and shipped a real-time multi-branch liquidity dashboard.
Established CI/CD on Firebase Hosting and Heroku for continuous delivery.
Shipped AI conversational commerce features in React across 3 channels: WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, and Discord.
Built Go and PostgreSQL services on AWS for high-concurrency messaging workflows.
Migrated the unified customer inbox from Redux to Jotai, cutting state-management surface area.
Built engagement analytics dashboards and instrumented the platform with Datadog.
Directed frontend architecture for a Web3 social platform verifying cross-chain assets and NFTs.
Migrated a legacy Angular codebase to React and Next.js, improving load performance, SEO, and scalability.
Engineered multi-wallet authentication ahead of WalletConnect across multiple blockchain protocols.
Led a distributed frontend team and set coding standards, performance benchmarks, and automated testing.
Led frontend delivery in Angular and React across concurrent client accounts.
Engineered NestJS APIs and ArangoDB data models to close the full-stack loop.
Authored software requirements specifications and development roadmaps.
Directed 4 technical functions: web engineering, UI/UX, IT infrastructure, and digital marketing.
Supervised offshore teams building React, Angular, Node.js, and WordPress products.
Owned budgets, timelines, and QA across the SDLC and led technical hiring.
Set technical strategy and converted business requirements into Agile sprint plans.
Governed the delivery lifecycle through code review, testing standards, and deployment gates.

items.role: Full Stack Engineer, then Frontend Developer
bullets: Delivered full-stack apps across React and Angular frontends, REST APIs, and schema design.
Shipped Ionic apps to the Apple and Google stores with in-app subscriptions and Stripe payments.
Configured CI/CD pipelines on AWS, Heroku, and Firebase for high-frequency releases.
Architected an Angular frontend and Spring Boot backend on AWS EC2 with Amplify CI/CD.
Integrated Stripe Connect across the stack to power a vendor-based marketplace.
Led technical workshops for engineering interns and reviewed all merged work.
Built an on-demand laundry marketplace in Ionic for iOS and Android, concept to alpha.
Engineered a serverless backend on Firebase Cloud Firestore and Cloud Functions with i18n for multi-region launch.
Deliver brand sites, e-commerce, and food-delivery management systems for small businesses.
Build with React and Node.js alongside WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace, and Wix.
Integrate payment gateways, CRM, and marketing automation, and tune SEO and accessibility.
